notes.title: Don't Play Our Demo!
notes.notes:
[b]Don't play our SSTR demo[/b] if you hate puzzles, get frustrated easily, cant think under pressure, don't like to read and get scared at the drop of a hat!

[b]SSTR[/b] is a sci-fi horror escape room puzzle game set aboard the colony ship Horizon.
We developed our demo to test out core functionality of the game and puzzle mechanics.
Play the demo and see if you can solve the puzzles, if you enjoy it please tell a friend!
[b]Full game will be story driven[/b] and will release February 2021.
